description:
You are logged into wger fitness manager at http://localhost as admin (username: admin, password: adminadmin). You are an Occupational Health Nurse (OHN) at Meridian Industrial Services, a manufacturing company with 800 employees. Following this year's biometric health screening, you have identified 3 employees with elevated cardiovascular risk profiles who need to be enrolled in the company's Employee Wellness Program.

A detailed program enrollment brief has been placed at /home/ga/Documents/occ_health_enrollment_brief.txt. It contains employee information, the group exercise program structure, and nutrition guidelines.

Complete ALL of the following:
1. Register each of the 3 employees as wger users (with the exact credentials specified)
2. Create the ergonomic intervention workout routine with the specified training days, day-of-week assignments, and exercises
3. Create the Metabolic Risk Reduction nutrition plan with the specified macro goals
4. Create the 5 named meals within the nutrition plan
5. Create the 2 body composition measurement categories specified in the brief

All usernames, email addresses, routine names, day names, day-of-week assignments, exercise names, nutrition plan details, meal names, measurement categories, and units must exactly match the specification document.

metadata.expected_routine_description: 12-week cardiovascular risk reduction program for sedentary manufacturing workers
